segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Casual, what's up?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Sao vậy?] [EN: Wife.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Vợ.] [EN: On the table.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Trên bàn.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Cho nên.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: So, that's why.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Tall is] [VI_F: Cao.] [EN: a flat tone. Short, in height, is] [VI_F: Thấp.] [EN: a high, rising tone. He is tall.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh ấy cao.] [EN: She added] [VI: ấy,] [EN: which after a pronoun means that person —] [VI: anh ấy] [EN: is he. Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Cute, or lovable, is] [VI_F: Dễ thương.] [EN: relax your lips for this vowel. Kind, or gentle, is] [VI_F: Hiền.] [EN: a falling tone. She is very kind.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị ấy rất hiền.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. Tall.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Cao.] [EN: Short.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Thấp.] [EN: Cute.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Dễ thương.] [EN: Kind.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Hiền.] [EN: He is tall.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh ấy cao.] [EN: She is very kind.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị ấy rất hiền.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Thấp.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Short.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Hiền.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Kind, gentle.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Bạn anh trông sao?] [VI_M: Anh ấy cao, dễ thương, và rất hiền.] [VI_F: Vui nha.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say, he is tall.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh ấy cao.] [EN: Say, she is very kind.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị ấy rất hiền.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you describe a friend. The preview word is] [VI: trông] [EN: which means to look, to appear.]
